contract: TSM Evidence Analysis Presentation and Runtime Planes

planes.name: evidence
planes.purpose: Immutable source records, acquisition metadata, hashes, provenance, review state and human attestations.

planes.name: analysis
planes.purpose: Reprojection, terrain derivatives, hydraulic models, simulations, uncertainty calculations and engineering computations.

planes.name: presentation
planes.purpose: Maps, 3D tiles, photogrammetry, visualization and user interaction.

planes.name: runtime
planes.purpose: Signed or hash-addressed deployment snapshots and executable state.

rules: Software provenance and data provenance are separate chains.
The chains may be joined only through recorded build/runtime identity.
Presentation output cannot upgrade evidence authority.
Analysis output must retain material input and transformation lineage.
Runtime promotion requires artifact integrity evidence and corresponding data-manifest evidence when local data are packaged.
